limits: Starts from the rejected serialized adaptive-flow candidate, including known failures. Earlier inverse-fourth map global injectivity is not established.
One common subsequent compact flow maps all76 muscles and16 diagnostic bones. Fixed HRA geometry is unchanged but not a fixed-point surface of this flow.

Each of12 training bones contributes128 source area points to one-way nearest-target loss and128 target area points projected to INITIAL source triangles. Reverse targets retain fixed material correspondences during this run: this is not dynamic reverse closest-surface loss or anatomical landmark matching.

Patella/L1/L6 excluded from fitting; full bidirectional vertex distances evaluate all16 bones. HRA hierarchy can include inner/cartilage boundaries; equal anatomical boundary semantics are not established.

Skin controls include32 area samples per muscle plus up to32 spatially diversified highest-distance outside vertices selected from EVERY initial referenced muscle vertex. Biased extreme controls are not an unbiased estimate of full-surface error. Skin weight2 is an optimization choice, not clinical guidance.
Only unanimous outside distances beyond2mm contribute skin loss. Inside/band/ambiguous points are unpenalized in that evaluation. The band is not an anatomical safe margin.

Seven explicitly selected vagina/vein versus muscle pairs add fixed initial material goals. Every target vertex and512 area samples are classified against the closed initial muscle, not against the open target. Up to64 diversified deepest inside points per pair project to initial muscle triangles and target a0.25mm displacement beyond the fixed point. This is a numerical hypothesis and soft penalty, not an anatomical clearance, dynamic occupancy objective, universal vessel/nerve exclusion, or guaranteed correct side.

Three ligament relations are held out from exclusion because attachment/continuity cannot be judged by a crossing flag. Closed edge topology does not establish absence of self-crossings or filled tissue interpretation; ambiguous samples are recorded and not used as inside controls.

Actual sampled loss is checked after every trial with halving. Full skin, all89794 runtime relationships, all1216 source-bone relationships, all saved target vertex/area queries and raw-source internal relationships are re-evaluated after fitting.
Each additional step has derivative bound below1. This does not prove inherited-map injectivity, discrete triangle topology, absence of self-crossings, anatomy or biomechanical validity.
